provenance.referenceRole: Visual observation only. No pixel sampling, palette clustering or residual reconstruction.
provenance.scaffold: User-supplied line-atelier-v5(1).html: whole-part geometry and visible contour scaffold
provenance.authoredChanges: 103 new line paths, 3 contour revisions, 18 additional shadow shapes, long highlights, local corrections and final accents; submitted through WebMCP.
provenance.limitations: Stylized redraw. Not a reproduction of the video artwork quality, and not an independent from-blank construction of every contour.
